description_en: Conducts a streaming conversation with JVS Crew, using the Server-Sent Events (SSE) protocol to push conversation content in real time
description_zh: 与 JVS Crew 进行流式对话，采用 Server-Sent Events (SSE) 协议实时推送对话内容
kebab_example: aliyun wuyingai chat --input '[{"Role":"user","Content":[{"FileUrl":"/workspace/report.pdf","Type":"text","FileName":"report.pdf","ImageUrl":"https://example.com/img.jpg","Text":"帮我分析这张图片"}]}]' --session-id test-session-001 --routing-key example-string --authorization Bearer%20eyJhb0000...0000k --external-user-id test-user --template-id template-abc123 --stream-options IncludeReasoning=false IncludeToolCalls=false --settings OutputFileMode=url --model example-string --resume true --region cn-hangzhou
name: Chat

parameters.description_en: The streaming output control options. Contains IncludeReasoning (boolean, default true, specifies whether to include the model thinking process) and IncludeToolCalls (boolean, default true, specifies whether to include tool invocation details). If not specified or set to a null object, the behavior is consistent with the legacy version.
parameters.description_zh: 流式输出控制选项。包含 IncludeReasoning（boolean，默认 true，是否包含模型思考过程）和 IncludeToolCalls（boolean，默认 true，是否包含工具调用详细信息）。不传或传空对象时行为与旧版一致。

fields.description_en: Specifies whether to include the model thinking process. When set to false, the SSE stream does not include messages with Type="reasoning" or their content events.
fields.description_zh: 是否包含模型思考过程。设为 false 时，SSE 流中将不包含 Type="reasoning" 的 message 和其 content 事件
fields.help_en: Specifies whether to include the model thinking process. When set to false, the SSE stream does not include messages with Type="reasoning" or their content events
fields.help_zh: 是否包含模型思考过程。设为 false 时，SSE 流中将不包含 Type="reasoning" 的 message 和其 content 事件
fields.name: include_reasoning

fields.description_en: Specifies whether to include tool invocation details. When set to false, the SSE stream does not include messages of type plugin_call, plugin_call_output, mcp_call, or mcp_call_output, or their content events.
fields.description_zh: 是否包含工具调用详情。设为 false 时，SSE 流中将不包含 plugin_call/plugin_call_output/mcp_call/mcp_call_output 类型的 message 和其 content 事件

fields.name: include_tool_calls
